notes: I opened two GSA pages and found no Illumina price data. The GSA eLibrary search URL returned 'Unable to access GSA eLibrary. Please Try Later.' The GSA Advantage search URL I guessed returned HTTP 404. A web search for GSA Advantage Illumina NovaSeq listings returned no gsaadvantage.gov or gsaelibrary pages. Illumina's own order pages show blank or sign-in prices. Government Scientific Source (govsci.com) has NovaSeq 6000 SKU pages (20028313 S4 200-cycle, 20028400 SP 300-cycle, 20040719 SP 200-cycle), but the known list already covers GSS/ECAT SKU pages. I did not open those pages or the Illumina order pages, and I did not try the VA NAC FSS. The result is inconclusive, not proof that nothing is there. The eLibrary outage may be temporary, and GSA Advantage is a JavaScript app that may need a different URL form.
how_to_mine: 1) Retry gsaelibrary.gsa.gov later and search 'Illumina' to get the contract number(s). It is probably MAS (Multiple Award Schedule), Schedule 66 / SIN 334516, possibly through resellers such as VWR, Fisher or Government Scientific Source. 2) If it loads, open the contractor page and download the price list and modification PDFs (the PDFs can be fetched directly). 3) For GSA Advantage, use the real search URL form (gsaadvantage.gov/advantage/search/headerSearch.do?q=...) and query catalog numbers: 20028312, 20028313, 20028400, 20040719, 20104706, 20125968 and 20125967. These are the NovaSeq 6000 S4, SP, X 25B-300, 25B-200 and 25B-100 catalog numbers. 4) Compare the govsci.com prices for the same catalog numbers against Illumina list prices to estimate the government discount. 5) If the 25B and 10B kits are not listed, check the VA NAC / Federal Supply Schedule (FSS) contract portal (VA FSS price lists are public PDFs).
new_candidates: govsci.com product-detail pages for NovaSeq X 10B/25B catalog numbers (20104706, 20125968, 20125967). Compare their prices with the 6000 S4 and SP kit pages for a 6000-vs-X $/Gb gap from a reseller. Check the known list's GSS coverage first for overlap.
